rationale.summary: No blockers found. Today's zero-trade session was caused by genuinely low confidence across all 22 symbols in a regime-unstable market (4 regime transitions). The organism's gate pipeline operated exactly as designed — refusing to force entries when breakout+tension signals were below 0.25. All infrastructure is healthy. Brain state is consistent. No code changes are warranted.
rationale.why_not_tweak: The exploration gate at 0.25 is already low. Lowering it further would force entries on symbols with near-zero breakout/tension scores, which historically produce negative expectancy. Today's best candidate (TSLA at 0.22) was in a trending_down regime — exactly the kind of trade the gates are designed to reject. Zero-trade days are a feature, not a bug, in a learning-mode organism.
rationale.market_context: Mar 11 was a choppy day with high regime instability (trending_up → trending_down → high_vol → low_vol). The market scanner returned zero movers all day. This is not the organism being broken — it's the organism correctly reading a no-edge environment.
rationale.progress_to_phase_transition: 142/300 trades to evolution freeze threshold. At ~24 trades/active-day (prior average), approximately 7 more active trading days needed to reach 300 trades and unlock evolution + ML training.
